items.heading: Company Titles Are Messy
items.text: Company titles are messy. A "Digital Marketing Manager" at a 20-person startup and a "Digital Marketing Manager" at a large FMCG brand can mean two very different jobs. What stays consistent across companies is the shift in what you are actually trusted to decide, so that is what each rung below is built around.

visuals.heading: This Is Where the Job

figures.label: Pay Range
figures.source: This is where the job stops being channel work entirely. A Head of Digital or Senior Manager (roughly 8-12 years) owns cross-channel strategy and a bigger team. A VP of Marketing or CMO (typically 12-20+ years) owns P&L, brand positioning, and the marketing function's seat at the leadership table. Senior manager-level digital marketing pay in India runs roughly ₹35-90 LPA at 8+ years, and Director/VP/CMO compensation stretches from roughly ₹50 LPA past ₹1 crore, heavily dependent on company size, industry, and whether equity is part of the package.

figures.label: Pay Range
figures.source: You now own one channel end to end: SEO, paid media, content, email/CRM, or social. Titles here vary a lot by company (SEO Specialist, Performance Marketing Associate, Content Strategist), but the underlying shift is the same: you are trusted with a budget or a metric, not just a task list. Pay typically moves to roughly ₹6-14 LPA depending on the channel and how measurable your results are.
